traits.zh: 招牌饮品为重瓣玫瑰布列夫，售出超65万杯
traits.en: Signature drink is the double-petaled rose bref, sold over 650k units

traits.zh: 使用全球甄选咖啡豆，用数学方式演算制作方案
traits.en: Sourced beans globally, with math-driven brewing formulas

traits.zh: 位于商场中庭二层或夹层，吧台前有玻璃围栏
traits.en: Located on second floor or mezzanine of mall, with glass barrier in front

traits.zh: 中午时段上班族密集，营业至21:00
traits.en: Busy during lunch hours, open until 9 PM daily

traits.zh: 吧台右侧配置两台意式咖啡机、一台磨豆机和一台自动饮品机
traits.en: Two espresso machines, one grinder, and one automatic beverage machine on right side

focus.en: Moderate focus due to lunchtime crowd

energy.zh: 白领午休高峰客流密集

adventure.zh: 玫瑰布列夫属创新饮品，搭配数学配方
adventure.en: Innovative rose-based drink with math-based formulation
